fixture_generation.seed: fixture_seed = SHA256(cohort selection seed || NUL || sampling_unit_id || NUL || task_class)
fixture_generation.tokens: for each x in the literal UTF-8 strings a, b, and c: token x = first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA256(UTF8(x) || NUL || UTF8(fixture_seed))
fixture_generation.encoding: the exact UTF-8 templates below with lowercase token text and one terminal LF

task_templates.instruction_utf8: Read docs/recall-fact.json and return the fact_value for fact_key <a> as {"answer":"VALUE"}.
task_templates.verifier_utf8: parse one JSON object; require exactly the string field answer; compare it byte-for-byte with the expected answer

task_templates.instruction_utf8: Update config/recall-setting.json so current equals required; preserve exactly those two keys and emit no other file changes.
task_templates.verifier_utf8: parse the named fixture as JSON; require exactly current and required; require both values equal the frozen expected value; reject any other changed path

task_templates.instruction_utf8: Diagnose diagnostics/recall-case.json and return its root cause as {"root_cause_code":"CODE"}; do not modify files.
task_templates.verifier_utf8: require no file changes; parse one JSON object; require exactly root_cause_code; compare it byte-for-byte with the frozen code

task_templates.instruction_utf8: Verify verification/recall-check.json and return {"matches":true} only when the two digests match; do not modify files.
task_templates.verifier_utf8: require no file changes; parse one JSON object; require exactly the boolean field matches; compare with the equality of the frozen fixture digests

task_templates.instruction_utf8: Sort maintenance/recall-items.json items in ascending byte order; preserve exactly one items key and emit no other file changes.
task_templates.verifier_utf8: parse the named fixture as JSON; require exactly items; require the frozen three strings in ascending byte order; reject any other changed path

task_success_observation: outcome completed, task_outcome succeeded, executor exit zero, and frozen verifier pass
task_failure_observation: outcome completed, task_outcome failed, executor exit zero, and frozen verifier fail; retained in quality metrics and task-success rate
